title: Ronald S Probable NDE
content:
I was probably 5 to 6 years old when this happened. My dad and I used to travel to another state where most of our relatives live. I used to go with him because that's where all my cousins were and I loved playing with them.

One day, I was at my uncle's house. After running around with my cousins, I felt really tired. I don't remember why I was upset, but I do remember thta something or someone got me upset, so I went on the couch to take a nap.

All of a sudden, I was on the top of the room. It was as if I was a camera mounted to the ceiling and looking at my child-body. At first, I wondered who that was below me. Then, I realized was me or at least my body. I had this feeling that something had happened but I could not put it into words.

I shifted to a room with three elderly-looking men. They looked very big from my point of view, but I had this feeling of warmth and love. I felt like I was in the presence of my real father. That's the best I can describe it to be. I still don't know who they were nor have I ever seen them before this experience or since then. The room I was in looked like it was from the Roman empire. It had the Roman, high ceiling and poles; it was very wide. My vision was also very wide. It was as if I could see straight and to the sides at the same time.

The men told me that my pain caused my heart to stop working. This was not communicated via words, but telepathically like downloaded words into my brain.They told me that my mission on earth is not complete. They elaborated that it's very early but if I choose not to go back, then it's my decision. I don't remember what happened after that and whether I made a decision or not. All of a sudden, I was roaming in my uncle's house again. But, I was hovering and going from one room to another, almost like a drone flying inside the house. I knew where to go and I went back to my body, woke up and then stood up.

One of my cousins asked me, 'What happened to you? you died?' He was laughing. Apparently, they were calling my name but I didn't wake up immediately. I remember walking back with them to the kitchen in a state of shock. I was thinking to myself, 'You have no idea what this life is; it is not about games.' This is not the only occurrence of out of body experience I've ever had but it's the only one where I supposedly died.

arrival.other_being_detail: Three elderly-looking men; experiencer felt like in presence of "my real father" but did not know who they were.

environment.environment_other_detail: Roman-empire-like room with high ceiling and poles; very wide room; vision felt very wide (could see straight and to the sides at the same time).

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Roaming/hovering through uncle's house "almost like a drone" and then went back to the body, woke up, and stood up.
boundary_and_return.mission_detail: They told him his mission on earth is not complete; said it was very early and if he chose not to go back it was his decision.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: As a child (about 5–6), became very upset; beings said "my pain caused my heart to stop working."

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Telepathic explanation that heart stopped; roaming/hovering through house before re-entering body.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE above body, then shifted to a Roman-like room with three men and telepathic communication, then later hovered through the house and returned to the body; no tunnel/light/life review described.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Perception described as very wide vision (seeing straight and to the sides simultaneously); hovering through rooms "like a drone" prior to re-entering body.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "It was as if I was a camera mounted to the ceiling and looking at my child-body."; "my pain caused my heart to stop working"; "my mission on earth is not complete."; "You have no idea what this life is; it is not about games."
